faqs.question: How long does an ERP implementation take?
faqs.answer: Most projects go live in 8-16 weeks depending on scope, data readiness, and integrations.

faqs.question: Can 4S Systems integrate with our existing tools?

faqs.question: Do you provide training and ongoing support?

hero.title: FAQs
hero.description: Everything you need to know about implementation, security, and pricing.

faqs.question: What is 4S Systems?
faqs.answer: 4S Systems is an ERP platform and services team that helps businesses modernize operations and reporting.

faqs.question: Which industries do you serve?
faqs.answer: We serve manufacturing, retail, distribution, services, and other operations-heavy businesses.

faqs.question: Can I start with a few modules and expand later?
faqs.answer: Yes. The platform is modular so you can add capabilities as your business grows.

faqs.question: Is there a mobile app?
faqs.answer: Yes, teams can access key workflows and dashboards from mobile devices.

faqs.question: Do you support Arabic and English?
faqs.answer: Yes. The platform supports Arabic and English across the UI and reports.

faqs.question: What does the implementation process look like?
faqs.answer: We start with discovery, configure modules, migrate data, train teams, and support go-live.

faqs.question: Do you handle data migration?
faqs.answer: Yes. We plan, clean, and migrate data with validation and parallel testing.

faqs.question: How do you train our teams?
faqs.answer: Training is role-based with workshops, documentation, and post-launch enablement.

faqs.question: How long is the typical rollout?
faqs.answer: Most projects complete in 8?16 weeks depending on scope and integrations.

faqs.question: Will you assign a project manager?
faqs.answer: Yes. A dedicated project manager coordinates timelines, milestones, and training.

faqs.question: How is our data protected?
faqs.answer: We use secure access controls, encryption, and best-practice monitoring.

faqs.question: Can we host on-premise or in the cloud?
faqs.answer: Yes. We support both deployment models based on your requirements.

faqs.question: Do you offer backups and disaster recovery?
faqs.answer: Yes. We design backup, recovery, and continuity plans aligned to your SLA.

faqs.question: Who can access our data?
faqs.answer: Access is role-based with audit logs to track activity.

faqs.question: Is data encrypted in transit and at rest?
faqs.answer: Yes. We use industry-standard encryption for data protection.

faqs.question: How is pricing structured?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on modules, users, and deployment. We provide clear tiered proposals.

faqs.question: Are there any setup or onboarding fees?
faqs.answer: Implementation services are scoped separately so you only pay for what you need.

faqs.question: Can we get a custom quote?
faqs.answer: Yes. Contact us for a tailored proposal based on your scope and timeline.

faqs.question: Do you offer monthly or annual billing?
faqs.answer: We can structure billing to match your procurement process and timeline.

faqs.question: Can I start small and scale pricing later?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pricing scales with modules and users as you grow.

faqs.question: Do you build modern websites?
faqs.answer: Yes. We design and build modern, high-performance websites tailored to your brand.

faqs.question: What tech stack do you use for websites?
faqs.answer: We build with Next.js and React, and choose the best tools for performance and SEO.

faqs.question: Can you handle design and development?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We cover discovery, UX/UI design, development, and launch.

faqs.question: Do you optimize for SEO and performance?
faqs.answer: Yes. We focus on Core Web Vitals, clean code, and SEO best practices.

faqs.question: Can you maintain and update the website after launch?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer ongoing updates, content support, and improvements as needed.

recruitment.title: Recruitment Services for Egypt & GCC
recruitment.description: Hire technical, ERP, business, and management talent with structured screening and strong role-fit.
paragraphs: 4S Recruitment Services helps leading enterprise organizations across Egypt and the GCC hire high-impact talent fast, accurately, and with strong role-fit. We recruit across technical roles including AI/ML, data, software engineering, cloud, cybersecurity, QA, and ERP specialists, as well as business and management functions such as program/project management, product, operations, finance, risk, CX, and transformation.

Our approach combines structured requirements intake, market mapping, rigorous shortlisting, technical screening, competency-based interviews, and reference checks. Clients receive a curated pipeline of candidates aligned with their capabilities roadmap, culture, and performance expectations.
points: AI/ML, data, software engineering, cloud, cybersecurity, QA, and ERP specialists
Program/project management, product, operations, finance, risk, CX, and transformation roles
Technical screening, competency interviews, and reference checks

chatbotWhatsapp.title: Chatbot & WhatsApp Self-Service Channels
chatbotWhatsapp.description: Automate customer journeys through chatbot and WhatsApp channels with secure API-first integrations.
paragraphs: 4S Chatbot & WhatsApp Self-Service Channels enable organizations to design and automate end-to-end customer journeys across digital touchpoints, reducing routine workload while improving response speed and customer satisfaction. The service focuses on high-volume repeatable inquiries such as appointment booking, request/status tracking, FAQs, service requests, and guided forms, with smart routing and escalation to live agents when needed.

The solution integrates with existing systems through API-first integrations and secure enterprise practices, making the chatbot a practical extension of business operations, not a standalone tool. 4S also provides journey design, conversation flows, knowledge structuring, analytics dashboards, and continuous optimization to increase self-service adoption.
points: Appointment booking, status tracking, FAQs, service requests, and guided forms
Smart routing and escalation to live agents
API-first integrations with existing enterprise systems
Journey design, knowledge structuring, analytics, and optimization
